description: Write or overwrite files in the site's editable source tree (the first write creates it). The served files do not change until build_and_deploy runs. Use list_source_files first to see what exists. A legacy site without source storage returns SOURCE_STORAGE_NOT_ENABLED; the user can ask VibeDeploy support to enable it.

files.description: Files to write into the source tree. Same wire shape as add_files. Re-writing a path overwrites the previous source. Per-file cap 5 MB; per-call cap 50 MB; max 200 files per call.

content.description: File content: text, or base64 as set by encoding.

encoding.description: utf8 (default), base64 (binary files), or gzip+base64 (gzip locally, then base64; fits about 3x more text per call).

path.description: Path inside the source tree, e.g. 'src/App.tsx'. Plain ASCII, no leading slash.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: write_source_files

warnings.description: Secret-scanner findings in the written files that did not block the write. Malicious content blocks the whole call with MALICIOUS_CONTENT; dotfiles other than .well-known/ and build config (.npmrc, .nvmrc, .env.example, ...) are rejected with INVALID_PATH.

title: Write files into the editable source tree
